瞿家是A市四大家族之一，与上官家一起，经常出席各大宴会。

上官程因为身体孱弱的原因鲜少出席这类活动，偶尔参加也时常戴着口罩。但二人还是在不久前的一次晚宴中有过一面之缘。

当时上官程正坐在会场的角落，摘下口罩喝私人医生送来的汤药。难得展露容颜，引得不少人侧目偷看，或赞美，或叹息。毕竟他那张脸，即便放在美人堆里也是出挑的，却偏偏配了那样一副病骨，难以长久。

不少人是有心与其结交的，但他玉面阎罗的恶名在外，且极度厌女，所以大多数人只是远远看着，不敢靠近。

唯有瞿爽偏不知死活地走了过去。

那天她穿了一件紫色低胸礼服，笑得殷勤又谄媚，语气里带着刻意的娇软，说上官少爷一个人坐着多无聊呀，我陪你说说话吧。

那样的女人上官程见多了。无非是觉得他命短又财富滔天，想做他的寡妇，捡他的巨额遗产。她们的眼神里写满了算计，笑容里藏着天平，把感情当成一笔投资——而他的死亡，就是她们最期待的回报。

上官程对这种女人极为厌恶，尤其是瞿家之人，更遭人烦。

瞿家，名义上是艺术世家，家中收藏着数不清的古董宝器。可实际上，他们却是一群靠挖墓盗财起家的贼！各个自私自利，为达目的不择手段，是四大世家中最为臭名昭著的。

所以当时上官程一个字也没与瞿爽多说，药没喝完便起身离开了。

如今与瞿爽突然撞见，上官程担心，万一对方认出他来，可能会带来不小的麻烦。

他正想着如何应对，却听对方道：“哟——这哪来的乡巴佬？该不会是你对象吧霖多多？”

闻言，上官程紧握的拳头倏然放松。

这女人，先前搭讪时说自己对他“一见钟情，难以忘怀”，恨不得把心掏出来给他看。如今他不过是换了件衣服，染了点尘土，便成了她嘴里的“乡巴佬”。

一见钟情，钟的果然只是那张脸、那身家世。

至于他这个人本身——她从来就没看见过。

“她是我呃....远房堂弟，阿九。”霖多多思量片刻，找出了这个身份。上官程已经有了独立人格，再把他当机器介绍给别人，实在不妥。而她一直把他当成初出茅庐的小崽子，弟弟的身份极为合适。

看到瞿爽像看垃圾一样看上官程，霖多多心里有些不舒服。

瞿爽处处针对她，经常对她冷嘲热讽，她知道这是对方的嫉妒心导致的，所以完全不在意。

The Qu family is one of the four major families in City A. Together with the Shangguan family, they often attend major banquets.

Shangguan Cheng rarely attends such events due to his frail health, and occasionally wears a mask when he does.But the two met at a dinner party not long ago.

At that time, Shangguan Cheng was sitting in the corner of the venue, taking off his mask and drinking the soup sent by his personal doctor.It was rare to show off her face, which attracted many people to peek, praise, or sigh.After all, his face would stand out even among beauties, but it would not last long with such a sick face.

Many people wanted to make friends with him, but because of his reputation as the Jade-Faced Yama, and his extreme misogyny, most people just looked at him from afar and did not dare to get close.

Only Qu Shuang walked over without knowing whether to live or die.

She wore a purple low-cut dress that day, smiled attentively and flatteringly, with a deliberately soft tone in her voice, and said how boring it was for Master Shangguan to sit alone. Let me talk to you.

Shangguan Cheng has seen many women like that.She just felt that his life was short and his wealth was huge, so she wanted to be his widow and collect his huge inheritance.Their eyes are full of calculations, their smiles are full of scales, and they regard their feelings as an investment - and his death is the return they are most looking forward to.

Shangguan Cheng was extremely disgusted with this kind of women, especially those from the Qu family, who were even more annoying.

The Qu family is nominally an artistic family, and there are countless antique treasures in their home.But in fact, they are a group of thieves who made their fortune by digging graves and stealing money!Everyone is selfish and uses any means to achieve their goals. They are the most notorious among the four major families.

So Shangguan Cheng didn't say a word to Qu Shuang at that time, got up and left before finishing the medicine.

Now that he suddenly bumped into Qu Shuang, Shangguan Cheng was worried that if the other party recognized him, it might cause a lot of trouble.

He was just thinking about how to respond when he heard the other party say: "Hey - where did this country bumpkin come from? Could he be your partner, Lin Duoduo?"

Hearing this, Shangguan Cheng's clenched fists suddenly relaxed.

This woman, when they talked to him earlier, said that she fell in love with him at first sight and was unforgettable, and she wanted to show him her heart.Now he just changed his clothes and got a little dust, and he became what she called a "country bumpkin".

It was love at first sight, and it turned out to be just that face and family background.

As for him himself—she had never seen him.

"She is my uh... distant cousin, Ah Jiu." Lin Duo thought for a moment and found out this identity.Shangguan Cheng already has an independent personality, so it would be inappropriate to introduce him to others as a machine.And she has always regarded him as a fledgling cub, and the identity of her younger brother is very suitable.

Seeing Qu Shuang looking at Shangguan Cheng like trash, Lin Duoduo felt a little uncomfortable.

Qu Shuang targeted her everywhere and often made sarcastic remarks to her. She knew that this was caused by the other person's jealousy, so she didn't care at all.
